description: An `Exception` that wraps a non-empty sequence of `Exception` instances, possibly including other groups.
The `BaseException` counterpart that may hold any exception; it becomes an `ExceptionGroup` when every member is an `Exception`.
Handles the members of a group by type: each clause gets a subgroup once, and unmatched members are re-raised as a group.
Select members by type, tuple of types or predicate, keeping message and nesting; `subgroup` returns `None` when nothing matches.
A member that is not itself a group; counting failures means walking nested groups down to the leaves.
